Regulation: B.C. Reg. 159/2026
Made under: Forest Act
Published in: No. 16 – B.C. Regs. 153 to 162, September 22, including September 8, 2026
Deposit date: September 22, 2026

B.C. Reg. 159/2026, deposited September 22, 2026, under theFOREST ACT[section 169]. Order in Council 406/2026, approved and ordered September 21, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that (a)	B.C. Reg. 134/2023 is amended in paragraph (b) by striking out "September 30, 2026" and substituting "September 30, 2028", and (b)	B.C. Reg. 34/2024 is amended in paragraph (b) by striking out "September 30, 2026" and substituting "September 30, 2028". — R. PARMAR,Minister of Forests; J. WHITESIDE,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. Index Page|Previous Regulation|Next Regulation|Cumulative Index Page Copyright © 2026: King's Printer, Victoria, British Columbia, Canada

minutes_briefs.title: BC extends two forest rules' deadlines from September 30, 2026 to September 30, 2028
minutes_briefs.summary: BC Regulation 159/2026 changes two existing forest regulations (B.C. Reg. 134/2023 and B.C. Reg. 34/2024). Both had a deadline of September 30, 2026 written into them. The new regulation replaces that date with September 30, 2028. This gives two more years before whatever those rules require must be met. The change was approved by Order in Council 406/2026 on September 21, 2026, and deposited on September 22, 2026.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Check whether your forestry operations rely on B.C. Reg. 134/2023 or 34/2024, and update your compliance calendar to the new September 30, 2028 deadline.

key_dates.label: Extended deadline for B.C. Reg. 134/2023 and 34/2024 requirements
